body.p: Dyooa. Dyooa lived alone in his tent. At some point, he looked at the smoke hole. Seven capercaillies sat on the smoke hole. I was sitting in my tent, I took my bow. I shot seven capercaillies through the smoke hole. Then I cooked them and ate them. After I ate, I fell asleep. I slept for seven days. I got surprised how long I have slept. Then I needed to pee, while I slept. I urinated, made a foresty river. This is how the river started. Then I needed to poop. Then I defecated, I laid down seven bunches. I ate seven capercaillies, I laid down seven bunches. Then the stream of the foresty river is strong, it is spinning. I said: "It would be good, it would be necessary for me to make a boat." I stood up on my feet, when my thing got erected, I rapped with a stick. I made a boat out of a tree bark. He sailed in a boat along the river. He is singing, making a song. The river went down into a lake. I needed to poop again. I see, there is a huge stone on the bank of the river. I moored my bark boat near the stone. I climbed the huge stone. I began to poop and pooped. Then the mother pike came and bit me on the balls. I began to shoot from my bow. I used all my arrows. The pike remained alive and went under the water. Well, let it be. The groin torn by the pike was covered in blood. What should I do? I cut off the lap of my sokuy, I tightened my balls, I tied up my things. I went by boat again. Autumn came. A tent appears ahead of him. In this tent, apparently, an old woman lives, an old man lives. Dyooa reached the tent, hid the boat, hid himself. Dyooa hid himself near the tent. In the evening, the old woman went outside and urinated. It is dark. Then Dyooa approached the old woman. Dyooa became a small child. Dyooa is crying, like a little child. The old woman found his with her hands, caught him. The old woman wrapped the child in her bosom. Then the old woman cried towards the tent: "Old man, I found a child for us, a boy.". The old man said: "Bring him to the tent, whatever he is, we will raise him like our child.". The old woman brought him to the tent, wrapped the child in bedding and put him. The old man is always fishing in the river, he gets fish. The old man makes dried fish from fresh fish. He makes a fish porridge out the dried fish. In the summer he puts it underground. The old man had a male reindeer, one reindeer. His reindeer is fat. While I live so, my son grew up. The old man said: "Old woman, let's move away, it's good. Let's go to the other side of the river." The boy said: "Daddy, you should kill the reindeer, I want meat." The old man doesn't want to kill it. The old woman said: "The only boy, how will you refuse, it is necessary to kill." The old man went outside, killed the reindeer, butchered it. The boy said: "Dad, let's move away, I'll put the reindeer's meat into my boat, I will take it to the other side of the river. You stay, I'll come back for you." They put the meat in the boat. The boy pushed the boat into the water and sailed away. The old man and the old woman were left alone. The boy reached the middle of the river and cried: "Where did you find me, I was not a child, I'm Dyooa." After that, the old woman and the old man stayed there. Dyooa is gone forever. Dyooa took away all the meat. They stayed alone and died of hunger. Dyooa then swims along the river, he again saw a tent in front of him. Dyooa hid the boat again. He has no meat, he ate it all. An old woman lives in this tent. Only Bunelya lives with her. His name is Bunelya. Dyooa reached the tent of the old woman. He came and stayed to live there. Then we get a lot of fish. We collect the fish caviar in a bast box (birch bark box). We have a lot of caviar. Dyooa became old. But Bunelya also became an old person. Well. Dyooa fell ill and said: "Nibiyu, when I die, put a barrel of caviar for the road for me, leave it to me." Dyooa fell ill and died. The old woman and Bunelya buried him at the cape of the river. They made a tomb tent for him. They put fish caviar also there, in this tomb tent. They buried Dyooa and left. After a while, Bunelya walks around Dyooa. Bunelya looks at the grave. Dyooa said: "Bunelya, hee hee." Bunelya got scared and ran away. He came home: "Nibiyu, Dyooa, in my opinion, seems to be alive." The old woman said: "I told you: just don't go near the dead person, you will have hallucinations.". Bunelya thought:"I will deal with Dyooa, he will get on his feet." Then Bunelya left, he went to Dyooa. Bunelya saw Dyooa and said: "Dyooa, a white bear is coming from the opposite side of the river, it has waded into the water." Dyooa: "A bear will pull out the dead person, the bear is coming." Dyooa broke the tomb tent, jumped to his feet and said: "Where are the bears, where?". Bunelya said:"Is that how I taught you a lesson?".
